title: Resource advisor
description: Suggestions to right-size limits, sleep idle apps and tune databases, worked out from this server's own usage history. Nothing changes until you apply one.

beta.label: Beta
beta.hint: In beta: suggestions come from local telemetry and can miss context only you know. Review each one before applying it.

empty.title: Nothing to tune right now
empty.description: Limits fit their usage and nothing looks idle or short of memory. The advisor checks again as new usage arrives.
empty.pendingDescription: The advisor needs at least a day of usage history before it suggests anything.

finding.notAllowed: You can view this suggestion but not change {{name}}.

settings.title: Beta features
settings.description: Features that work but are still being tuned. They are off by default and you can switch them off again at any time.
settings.advisorDescription: Suggests memory and CPU limits, flags idle apps and databases, memory growth and disk pressure, and sizes Postgres, Redis and MySQL settings from real usage. It only suggests: changes need your confirmation.
settings.locked: Turned on by APP_EXPERIMENTAL on the server. Remove it there to switch it off.
settings.error: Could not change the beta feature: {{message}}
settings.readOnly: Only an administrator can switch beta features.
settings.aiChatDescription: An assistant in the dock and on its own page that can look up apps, logs and deploys for you. It reads and suggests; anything that changes state asks you to confirm. You also need to connect an AI provider under AI assistant settings.
settings.cliConsoleDescription: A terminal in the dashboard that runs the command line tool as you, with Tab completion and history. It cannot reach the host shell, and every command is audited. Opening it needs a fresh password or passkey confirmation. Set APP_CLI_CONSOLE=off on the server to disable it entirely.
settings.mobileApiDescription: Lets you pair a phone from Settings, Mobile devices. A paired phone gets its own expiring token that can read status and restart, deploy or roll back apps, never root or secret values. Set APP_MOBILE_API=off on the server to disable it entirely.
settings.samlScimDescription: SAML 2.0 single sign-on and SCIM 2.0 user provisioning, built on the sign-in library, with Settings, Single sign-on. Beta, not yet tested against a live identity provider. While off, its routes answer 404, the sign-in button is hidden, and an earlier SSO enforcement setting is not applied.
settings.samlScimToggleLabel: Turn on SAML sign-in and SCIM
settings.samlScimTurnedOn: SAML sign-in and SCIM turned on
settings.samlScimTurnedOff: SAML sign-in and SCIM turned off
